title: Site top bar: a black full-width bar, a sticker wordmark, a white capsule for the current page, one acid capsule CTA, round icon buttons
use: The fixed top bar of a game's official site (1920 wide, 66 high). Six nav labels; the current one is a white capsule. Not for in-game HUD bars.

current.note: which nav item is the current page (white capsule)

more_caret.note: a caret after the sixth label (a 'more' menu)

icons.note: the three round icon buttons (music, community, account)

relations: Bar 66 units high, pure black, content between x 275 and 1620 (1370 wide, centred).
Current page: white capsule 103 x 35, black 900 text; others mute grey on black, 121-unit pitch.
One acid capsule CTA (100 x 33) after the nav, then three round buttons on a 70-unit pitch.
decoration: Cassette mark in the brand sticker, the caret, the three icons: drawn.

provenance.corpus: replay-ward case (回放街区 REPLAY WARD): our own original one-page game site and two in-game screens in the street-tape grammar
provenance.experiment: styles/street-tape/style.json provenance (reference board measured privately; never shipped)
provenance.method: Positions measured on the board's top bar (66 px, capsules 103 x 35 and 93 x 33) and kept in 1920 units; the case's bar is the same.
measured: Board: bar #000 66 px; current capsule 103 x 35 white; CTA 93 x 33 acid; nav pitch about 123 px.
Case: the brand Latin under the CJK name touched it at 2 px (8 text-overlap findings over 7 pages); the lockup is one block.
